facts.fact: The guide concerns obligations under the Data Protection Act 2017, with registration required of some 60,000 entities.
The Data Protection Commissioner, Drudeisha Madhub, and the Data Protection Office are named as running registration and DPO training.
Minister Avinash Ramtohul said on 29 October 2026 that only 23,000 of some 60,000 entities required to register under the Data Protection Act 2017 had done so.
